name: 60487 · Tinley Park, IL
findings: ZIP 60487 (Tinley Park) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60487 (Tinley Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60487 (Tinley Park) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
